excessive_privilege.recommended_treatment: Review and remove privileges that are not required for the approved business role.

privilege_creep.recommended_treatment: Review entitlements and revoke permissions that are no longer required.

inappropriate_permission.recommended_treatment: Validate the business requirement and correct inappropriate permissions.

abnormal_access.recommended_treatment: Review the access context and strengthen authentication or monitoring where justified.

unowned_account.recommended_treatment: Assign an accountable owner or disable the account if continued access cannot be justified.
